Ines Kerr's drawings of the Stour estuary at low tide. Private view on Thursday 20 November, 6 to 9pm.͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ 

The Saltworks

Harwich, Essex

You’re invited to a private view

Low
Water

New drawings by Ines Kerr

20

Thursday
November

6 to 9pm, music from 7

Ines Kerr, Low Water (Stour, 6.14am), 2026. Ink on paper, 76 × 43 cm.

For a year, Ines walked out onto the Stour estuary at every low tide she could reach before work, and drew what the water left behind. These are thirty-one of those drawings, shown together for the first time.

When

Thursday 20 November, 6 to 9pm

Where

The Saltworks, 2 Quay Lane
Harwich CO12 3HH

Getting here

Six minutes’ walk from Harwich Town station. The last train to London is at 22:04.

Access

Step-free throughout, with an accessible toilet on the ground floor.

Reply to say you’ll come

Add it to your calendar

During the show, until 18 January

22 Nov
2pm

Ines in conversation with Dafydd Rees, who has kept the Harwich tide gauge for thirty years.

7 Dec
10am

A drawing walk along the estuary at low tide. Bring boots; we’ll bring the paper.

15 Jan
6pm

A late opening, and the last chance to see the drawings together.

The Saltworks is open Wednesday to Sunday, 11am to 5pm, and free. You’re getting this because you’re on our list for openings. Leave the list.
